data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 reduces to SRC_002: the error-distribution-shape discriminator is a special case of the within-evaluation abstention, because a single evaluation's error patterns are themselves one sample from the deployment distribution and cannot establish cross-distribution reliability; it is refuted if a single evaluation's error pattern is proven sufficient to reconstruct the deployment-distribution expectation of accuracy without further sampling. The shape signal is one diagnostic clue; it never closes the generalization gap by itself.
